title: fix(sdk): return usage CSV exports as text
author: Connectslide121

gist.summary: Fixed SDK usage CSV exports: `accountUsage({ format: "csv" })` and `accountUsageDaily({ format: "csv" })` now return CSV text instead of throwing a JSON `SyntaxError`. Overloads type CSV results as `Promise<string>` for those methods and `getUsage()` / `getDailyUsage()`. The shared `getJson()` helper now accepts an optional body reader; an Unreleased changelog entry and regression tests cover both CSV methods.
